title: Reading a Number Bond
objective: Given an already-drawn bond (whole and both parts filled in), state what it says as a full sentence, and connect it back to objects if asked.
studentQuestion: What does this bond tell you?
newIdea: Fluently reading a bond, independent of having just built it.

teaching.setup: A pre-drawn, fully filled-in bond (e.g. whole 8, parts 6 and 2).
teaching.see: What does this picture tell us, without me saying anything?
teaching.break: Identify which number is the whole and which two are the parts.
teaching.build: State the relationship aloud: 8 is made of 6 and 2.
teaching.transform: The same bond, read starting from either part (6 and 2 make 8, or 8 is 6 and 2) — same relationship, either direction.

check.prompt: Build it with objects to confirm the bond is telling the truth.

examples.transfer: A bond with the parts listed in reverse position from the previous examples.

mastery.evidence: Reads a given bond correctly starting from the whole and starting from the parts, for two different bonds.
